claims.claim: Only the three authorized new diagnostic files were added. The command rejects every argument before experimentation and leaves existing diagnostic, fixture, production and lifecycle surfaces unchanged.

The primitive binds six fresh real-Git cases across both full-64-hex ref families and exact lengths 326, 327 and 328. Each case validates geometry before one checked PUSH, verifies local longpaths configuration, performs update-ref, and checks successful remote show-ref and origin ls-remote resolution without retries.

Durable output contains only closed typed facts and factual relationships. Stderr operands are redacted before bounded category and signature matching; dynamic operands, raw streams and object identities remain transient.

The envelope rejects subject mutation, dirty state, invalid geometry, missing or duplicate cases, resolution contradictions, schema defects and instrumentation failures. It reports observational relationships without causal or correction-selection fields.

Regression coverage implements argument rejection, fixed binding, geometry validation, real successful and failed checked-PUSH paths, all outcome vectors, cross-family comparisons, every stderr pattern, privacy rejection, subject mutation and malformed case rejection.

Regression code exercises the primitive using protocol inputs and short disposable Git repositories. No current-subject threshold experiment outcome, automatic continuation, correction selection or TASK-231 authorization was created.
